steps.name: sign in and open Payments in the dark theme; checkout section is there
open a checkout: the simulated checkout page appears with the price
paying queues an event but grants nothing yet
a delivery with the wrong secret is refused and records nothing
a correct delivery grants access and books revenue
delivering the same event again is ignored as a duplicate
a dispute pauses access; losing it revokes for good
out of order: a refund delivered before its payment still ends revoked
recent checkouts list both, and the first can be continued
